title: Private Tour of Multnomah Falls and Columbia Gorge
includes: Flexibility in the itinerary upon the traveler’s request.
Private transportation in a Mercedes Sprinter 2023
Private transportation in a Toyota Grand Highlander 2024 (small groups)
Seasonal snacks and refreshments throughout the tour.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This experience offers facilities for people in wheelchairs. However, there are certain optional spots where accessibility is only available via stairs.
Our vehicle is not equipped with a wheelchair ramp.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
There is no better way to discover the Columbia River Gorge, a must-visit destination when you're in Portland, than on a private tour just for you or with a companion.
From stunning waterfalls to iconic viewpoints, this is your chance to experience the Pacific Northwest at its finest. 
Book your tour today and let the magic of Multnomah Falls and the Gorge’s natural wonders captivate you!
